in_marathi.name: Devisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devisha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘isha’ meaning ruler or goddess. This name is often used for girls in Hindu culture and symbolizes the goddess of all gods. It is believed that the name Devisha bestows divine blessings and protection upon the child.
